summary: Verdict: NO_ADVERSE at 49% confidence. Patagonia, Inc. (founded 1973 by Yvon Chouinard, headquartered Ventura, CA) has no criminal convictions, material sanctions, or >$10 million judgments as of 2026-10-01; its ownership is split between the Patagonia Purpose Trust (voting) and Holdfast Collective (nonvoting, majority economic interest). A December 2021 ECCHR criminal complaint in a Dutch court did not result in charges or conviction.

findings.statement: Patagonia, Inc. is headquartered in Ventura, California and operates in the outdoor recreation clothing, equipment, and food retail industry.

Patagonia was founded in 1973 by Yvon Chouinard; as of 2026-10-01 its voting stock is held by the Patagonia Purpose Trust and its nonvoting stock by the Holdfast Collective, with the Holdfast Collective holding the majority of economic interest.

In December 2021 the European Center for Constitutional and Human Rights filed a criminal complaint against Patagonia in a Dutch court alleging complicity in forced labor of Uyghur Muslims; no subsequent criminal charges, indictment, or conviction against Patagonia have been reported as of 2026-10-01.

As of 2026-10-01 Patagonia has not been subject to any material civil judgment exceeding $10 million, major regulatory sanction, bankruptcy, insolvency proceeding, or been barred or sanctioned by a regulator such as the FTC, EPA, or CPSC.

conflict_notes: Conflicting descriptions of Patagonia's post-2022 ownership: some sources state voting stock transferred to Patagonia Purpose Trust and nonvoting stock to Holdfast Collective (Wikipedia), while others indicate the Holdfast Collective received 98% of shares (verfassungsblog) or that both trusts hold ownership (qz.com). Weighed the direct sources (qz.com, verfassungsblog) and the weaker Wikipedia entry, concluding that the voting trust holds voting shares and the Holdfast Collective holds nonvoting shares with the majority economic interest.
